# Kino plugins

> How to write, test and publish a source plugin (video, live TV, music, podcasts) for Kino, an Android app for phones and TVs. A plugin is a public GitHub repository (or, from Kino 0.9.50, any public https URL of its manifest) with a JSON manifest (kino-plugin.json) and one JavaScript ES module (plugin.js) that Kino runs in a QuickJS sandbox; it exports async functions (search, home, browse, episodes, resolve, and liveCategories/liveChannels/guide/liveSearch for live TV) that return plain JSON Kino validates strictly. apiVersion 1 to 14 (12, 13 and 14 arrive together in Kino 0.9.74, not released yet); apiVersion 6 = Kino 0.9.50, apiVersion 7 (tracking and segments) = Kino 0.9.51, apiVersion 8 (music and podcast items, the details export) = Kino 0.9.54, apiVersion 9 (the player panel, section.labelEn, settingsLayout, a hand-written plugin's fetchHosts: "any") = Kino 0.9.55, apiVersion 10 (the playlists capability -- a contract only, no plugin uses it yet) = Kino 0.9.65, apiVersion 11 (externalResolve) = Kino 0.9.66, apiVersion 12 (the syncProvider capability and the manifest's sync block, the link and help settings) = Kino 0.9.74 (not released yet; an action's setSettings and link answers and kino.sync.remoteChanged arrive with it, no new apiVersion), apiVersion 13 (the socket, byteSource, storageLarge, catalog, qrScan and imageSource capabilities, the settings form's qr type, "sync": false on a password or a text, settingsStatus hide, an action's setSettings on a password, sync.generateKey, a one-shot device-only password in sync.provision, and syncProvider next to socket/storageLarge/catalog/qrScan with no resolve or search; kino.crypto's byte operations aesIge/aesIgeVerify/modPow/gunzip/convert are gated on the Kino version, not the manifest: feature-detect each) = Kino 0.9.74 too, with 12 (not released yet; every Kino before 0.9.74 refuses both), apiVersion 14 (screens: the screen capability with the screen/screenEvent exports and the manifest's screen block, a full-screen canvas described as a JSON tree of Flutter-style nodes drawn on phone and TV; playerPanelTab, library, playerControl, room, schedule with jobs and job(ctx), shared, ai; the manifest's enhancements, read at any apiVersion; unlockWith on a toggle or select; kino.fetch maxBytes/stopAt) = Kino 0.9.74 too (not released yet); Kino 0.9.53 adds kino.meta and kino.tmdb with no new apiVersion (feature-detect them), and Kino 0.9.54 adds, with no new apiVersion, "catalogOnly" in the manifest and kino.browser.capture's captureAll options (feature-detect kino.browser.captureAll). A Node kit (sdk/) runs and validates plugins locally.

The preferred way to build a plugin's own UI (a screen, configuration, onboarding, dashboard or panel) is Kino's screens UI (apiVersion 14, `screen`/`screenEvent`); the old settings form and the legacy panel format stay for compatibility, and a plugin that must keep installing on older Kinos keeps its apiVersion and offers the screen through `enhancements`. Validate with `node sdk/validate.mjs .` and `node sdk/run.mjs . screen` (also `--device tv`).

Everything a person reads in Kino is Spanish (Bogotá, tuteo); from Kino 0.9.54 the app may speak English too, and kino.lang is then "en-US", so texts a plugin builds follow kino.lang. The guide exists in Spanish (default, site root) and English (/en/); the English pages are the ones below. For one-shot context, read llms-full.txt: every English page, AGENTS.md, contract.json and kino.d.ts in one file.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI assistants building a Kino plugin (workflow, hard rules with exact limits, checklist, common mistakes)
- [llms-full.txt](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/llms-full.txt): the complete guide as one text file
- [Home](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/): what a plugin is, how people install it (owner/repo, a kino-plugin.json URL on GitHub/raw/jsDelivr, or any public https manifest URL: no sealed secrets, unsigned, not in community search), the 5-minute path
- [A first plugin](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/first-plugin/): a two-file plugin and where the sdk/ kit comes from
- [Get listed in Kino](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/listed/): the five steps to show in the app's "De la comunidad" list (from the next Kino version, the tab of the store view filled by Kino Plugins) (public, not a fork, valid manifest with a Spanish name/description, topic kino-plugin), the order (from Kino 0.9.54: 100 at a time, Populares/Recientes, Cargar más, Buscar en GitHub; top 30 by stars on 0.9.53 and older), timing and how to check

## Guide

- [Signed plugins](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/signed/): optional apiVersion 5 author signature (Kino 0.9.45+): what it is, why it matters (trust on first use, "Firmado por su autor"), `node sdk/seal.mjs --keygen` / `--sign`, what the signature covers (sign again after every change), keeping the private key out of the repository, what happens if it is lost, error messages
- [What's new](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/changelog/): what changed for plugin authors by Kino version (the next version, in development: apiVersion 13 -- kino.ws sockets with hex/base64 frames, plugin-served byte streams with the read export, kino.catalog, storageLarge, the qr setting and kino.qr.scan, plugin-served images with the image export, kino.crypto byte operations, async answers freed from the 64 MB engine memory; 0.9.74 (not released yet): apiVersion 12, sync providers (syncPull, syncPush, syncStatus, the sync block with the required keySecret and provision, kino.sync.remoteChanged, kino.fetch caps raised inside sync calls), the link and help settings, an action's setSettings and "Is this you?" link answers, plugin request logs keep only the host; 0.9.66 (not released yet): apiVersion 11, the externalResolve capability and the externalResolver manifest field, a stream's advisory media and its portable copy; 0.9.65 (not released yet): apiVersion 10, the playlists capability, a contract only; 0.9.55: apiVersion 9, the player panel (panel, panelAction, playerEvent, settingsLayout), section.labelEn, a hand-written plugin's fetchHosts: "any"; 0.9.54: apiVersion 8 with music and podcast items, the details export, catalogOnly plugins, kino.browser.capture captureAll, kino.lang following the app's language, CloudStream plugins; 0.9.53: kino.meta asks Kino about a title, kino.tmdb is TMDB with no key in the plugin: Kino's own key first behind its cache and limits, the person's key as the fallback, no_tmdb_key only with no key at all; 0.9.45; 0.9.46-0.9.49: a leading "./" in entry/icon is only tolerated from 0.9.46 -- always write "plugin.js"; 0.9.50 = apiVersion 6: typed/larger sealed secrets, migrate, request-signed streams, settings form, debug, telemetry, section/categories/theme, scopedSearch, kino.error userMessage, adult entries, channels in Home rows, kino.crypto key pairs, the hidden browser (browser: true for kino.browser.capture, browser: "pages" adds kino.browser.page), Stream.label and labelled lazy copies, meta, Stream.alternatives, the subtitles export, Stream.skip, the manifest's categories field, telemetry-only log lines, genre on rows/live categories/playlists, playlist streamHeaders, catchable synchronous kino.* failures, the one-time plugin update pass after a Kino upgrade; also manifest-URL installs, liveSearch, live paging past 10 pages)
- [The manifest](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/manifest/): every field of kino-plugin.json (entry/icon never start with "./"; hosts have no maximum from Kino 0.9.45; the signature field; categories, browser, debug, telemetry, section, theme; capabilities migrate, scopedSearch, meta, subtitles, playlists (apiVersion 10, all six exports optional), externalResolve and syncProvider (apiVersion 12); the sync block; reserved ids), settings (incl. list, the apiVersion 6 section/status/action types and the apiVersion 12 link/help aids), streamHosts "any", sealed secrets (seal.mjs; typed cipher keys and 8 KB values at apiVersion 6), the person's own servers, insecureHttp, declarative downloads
- [The contract](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/contract/): exported functions, arguments, returned shapes, validation rules, Stream rules (alternatives, label, skip, signing), labelled lazy copies ({ label, ref } resolved through resolve(ref) only when picked or reached by the fallback), subtitles for any title, meta (describing other titles), scoped search inside "Ver más" (scopedSearch, within), asking about a forgotten host, the broad video permission, typed errors and kino.error's userMessage with its safety rules, 18+ content (adult) behind the person's PIN, the syncProvider exports (apiVersion 12) in short
- [The kino API](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/kino-api/): kino.fetch (request budget, host questions during resolve/episodes), cookies, kino.secret, crypto (incl. apiVersion 6 key pairs: generateKeyPair, sign, verify, importKey, deriveSharedSecret, with a Node/WebCrypto mapping), kino.browser (pointer to Hidden browser), kino.meta (Kino 0.9.53: Kino's TMDB/AniList/meta-plugin answer about a title, no key in the plugin, 30/min, null when unknown), kino.tmdb (Kino 0.9.53: read-only TMDB v3 with no key in the plugin -- Kino's own key first behind its cache and limits, the person's key (Ajustes, else a consented Stremio addon's) only as the fallback, no_tmdb_key only with no key at all; allowlisted paths, 40 per 10 s, 10-min cache, no hosts entry needed), kino.sync.remoteChanged (Kino 0.9.74, realtime sync providers only), the kino.fetch caps inside syncPull/syncPush, sleep, error (userMessage), config, html.select, storage, log (logcat tags, telemetry, kino.log.report), rank Also, apiVersion 13 (in development): kino.ws, kino.catalog, kino.qr.scan, storageLarge and the kino.crypto byte operations.
- [External resolver apps](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/resolver/): externalResolve (apiVersion 11, Kino 0.9.66): a plugin answers { external: { protocol, ref } } and an independently-installed resolver app turns it into a playable answer; the whole flow (consent per app, progress, 120 s, one hop), the answer (url on any public host or one loopback origin, media, portable, no DRM), errors the person reads (onError sentence, X-Resolver-Error), casting through Kino's proxy (not yet tried on real receivers), the manifest's externalResolver with an apk, how to build the resolver side (AIDL), security model, FAQ
- [Sync providers](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/sync-providers/): syncProvider (apiVersion 12, Kino 0.9.74): a plugin as the transport of the person's cross-device Kino sync; Kino encrypts the snapshot (AES-256-GCM) and hands the plugin an opaque base64 blob; who can read what (sync.keySecret is required: the key is derived on each device from a password setting holding a long random token, no key travels, the plugin and its service CAN read the data, one red consent line; from apiVersion 13 sync.generateKey makes Kino create that token itself); syncPull/syncPush/syncStatus with one object argument, version and expectedVersion, kino.error("conflict"), auth_required for missing setup; the sync block (mode poll/realtime, pullEveryMs, pushDebounceMs, maxBlobBytes up to 4 MiB, keySecret, provision, generateKey) and its messages; from apiVersion 13 syncProvider next to socket/storageLarge/catalog/qrScan needs no resolve or search; cadence and kino.sync.remoteChanged; the 4 MiB limit and the raised kino.fetch caps; "Enviar configuración" / "Recibir configuración" ("Send settings" / "Receive settings"; QR, typed address, 6-digit code, local network or a Cloudflare quick tunnel with public words gated by the code, 5 attempts, single use, 3 minutes; a "sync": false password as a one-shot secret, apiVersion 13); the provider cards by state ("Configurar" / "Set up"); profiles; security notes (token revocation, reset sync); testing; the example providers Sync-Gram (Telegram bot), Sync Servidor (own server) and Sync-Gram Cuenta (own Telegram account, apiVersion 13)
- [Sockets and plugin-served bytes](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/bytes/): apiVersion 13 (in development, not in a released Kino): socket (kino.ws: wss:// to declared hosts on port 443, 4 sockets, 8 MiB queued, 786,000-byte frames, hex/base64 frames without JavaScript loops), byteSource (resolve answers { source: "plugin", handle, size, mime }; Kino calls read({ handle, offset, length }) for 1 MiB at a time, 20 s each, one at a time, plays and casts it to Chromecast/DLNA, never downloads it), how to make reads fast, kino.crypto byte operations (aesIge, aesIgeVerify, modPow, gunzip, convert; gated on the Kino version, not the manifest: feature-detect each), a complete WebSocket file-library example with its kit test, run.mjs read and askRead
- [Catalog and large storage](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/catalog/): apiVersion 13 (in development): kino.catalog (upsert/search/get/remove/clear/count over one SQLite file per plugin, up to 100,000 items in 64 MiB, every-word accent-free search, no SQL, device-only), a runnable indexing mini-plugin, limits and errors, and storageLarge (kino.storage at 16 MB, 2 MB per value, 1,000 keys, device-only, not in backups)
- [Images from the plugin](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/images/): apiVersion 13 (in development): imageSource, { source: "plugin", handle } in poster/backdrop/still/hero image, the image({ handle }) export (base64 JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 256 KB, 10 s), one at a time and never during playback, disk cache, privacy (handles sync and go into backups), known limits, the kit's askImage
- [QR codes](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/qr/): apiVersion 13 (in development): the settings form's qr type (text from settingsStatus, refreshMs 2000 to 60000) and kino.qr.scan (qrScan; only from a settings action, panelAction or a screenEvent the person pressed, phone only, 120 s, busy/timeout/unavailable/not_allowed/permission_denied), a two-device login recipe, the kit's qrScan fake
- [Screens](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/screens/): apiVersion 14 (Kino 0.9.74, not released yet): the screen capability, the manifest's screen block (label, icon/iconFile, menuOpens, opensFrom, settingsButton, settingsIn, replaces, every, adult), screen(ctx) and screenEvent(ev), Kino-kept state and state.inputs, what an answer may carry (state, toast, banner, popup, go, ui ops, config), lists and load more, forms and validation, the settings node, bind and config, every go shape (title, play, search, browse, section, categories, close, screen, titleByIds, url, copy, liveChannel, routes), timers (every), TV text input and focus rules (canRequestFocus), screen limits, the consent model of the apiVersion 14 capabilities, testing with the kit (run.mjs screen/screenEvent/--device tv/--state/--context), patterns, the examples (UI gallery, Solo noticias, Party Chat), known limits
- [Components: layout, content and actions](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/screen-components/): every screen component with its property table, JSON and phone/TV behaviour: Column, Row (twelve-column wrap), Stack and positioned children, Spacer/SizedBox, Divider, scroll, GridView, ListView (newItemsHint), TabBar, ExpansionTile, steps, Card, Scaffold, AppBar (title takes any node), NavigationBar, PageView and the carousel, ListTile, Text (with a time), text scale, colours, Image, Icon and the icon names, Badge, CircleAvatar, MaterialBanner, progress indicators, Skeleton, QrImage (expiring codes), DataTable, emptyState, errorState, titleCard/titleRail/titleGrid/heroCard, buttons (loading, timeoutMs), FloatingActionButton, Tooltip, Chips, toasts, local ui operations
- [Components: forms, overlays and navigation](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/screen-forms/): Form, TextField (secret obscureText, several lines), DropdownButton, RadioGroup, Checkbox, Switch, Slider, NumberStepper, TV focus looks, validation and Kino's pattern matcher, submit rules, the settings node and onSaved, bind and config, Dialog, Sheet, Menu, declared pop-ups with onClose, anchored pop-ups (anchor), every go shape and routes
- [Components: state, style and recipes](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/screen-reference/): state, state.inputs, events, answers, timers, per-size values (compact/medium/expanded), the Flutter-style name table, style, the common, shared and box/text property tables, animations (animate, opacity, visible), tokens, every screen limit, and recipes (news grid, settings form with validation, confirmation pop-up, tabs with chips, button matrix, Scaffold with app bar, tabs and FAB, tabs in the app bar)
- [Rooms, the library and player control](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/rooms/): apiVersion 14: kino.library (watched and saved, never 18+, rounded, permission_denied when switched off), playerControl (pause, resume, seek and speed from a panel's refreshMs or playerEvent; Kino's notice; 30 a minute), kino.room (open/join with words and a code, send/inbox/members, end-to-end encrypted with the code over a Cloudflare quick tunnel from the person's own device, TTL up to 4 h, untrusted low-sensitivity messages), consent lines, limits, errors, the kit; Party Chat as the reference
- [Background jobs, shared results and AI](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/jobs-and-shared/): apiVersion 14: schedule with the manifest's jobs (1..3, everyOptions 15..1440 min, runOn "preferPhone") and job(ctx) (20 s, 10 requests, 2 MB, 256 KB of storage, 96 runs a day; Kino's rows in Ajustes; Wi-Fi only by default), kino.shared (4 JSON values synced between linked devices, never a secret, untrusted when read), kino.ai.ask (one short ask to Kino's text AI; never throws; untrusted reply), the kit (job, --device phone/tv, shared, KINO_AI_*); Solo noticias as the reference
- [Plugin stores](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/plugin-stores/): apiVersion 15 (the next Kino version, not published yet): pluginStore, a plugin that is a source of plugins for Kino's store; storeSync({ reason, since, state }) -> { full, entries, removed?, state? } (full list or changes, state <= 16 KB; 5,000 entries and 4 MB, 60 s and 40 requests, background only); local vs live stores (live must export storeList and storeSearch too: 5 s, 20 calls a minute, 30-minute cache); StoreEntry fields; how Kino mixes stores (local first, live appended, no repeats, one Cargar mas, one plugin per id across all stores and never the id kino-plugins), the tabs De Kino / De la comunidad (without Kino's list) / Instalados, the reload icon and its toast, since and state absent at any time (a store whose rows Kino lost is synced from scratch: answer the full list), the source badge, the blocklist (refreshed with every sync; Kino Plugins' daily index leaves blocked repos out) and the 18+ code applied by Kino, plugins that disappear, consent lines (a red one for a live store); Kino Plugins (1.0.1, ships inside Kino, signed with Kino's author key) as the worked example; kit commands and init --store
- [Example stores](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/store-examples/): two complete, copyable plugin stores with offline tests: a local one over a static JSON file and a live one over its own API
- [Identity](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/identity/): apiVersion 15: kino.identity.telegram({ challenge? }) -> { id, token } (+ deviceKey, signature, author, codeHash with a challenge); a per-plugin pseudonym, the signed token as a credential, only plugins signed with Kino's own author key get an answer; only in a call the person started; consent line in red; kit variables; Kino Social's login as the example
- [Notices in the bell](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/notifications/): apiVersion 15: kino.notifications.post/clear (id groups, title 80, text 160, go.screen), from a screen or the plugin's job; 20 posts an hour, 30 kept, 30 days; not synced; plain consent line; kit .kino-notices.json; Kino Social's notices job as the example
- [Screens without raising your apiVersion](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/enhancements/): the manifest's enhancements block keyed by apiVersion ("14": capabilities, screen, settings, panel, jobs), read by Kino 0.9.74 at any apiVersion and ignored by older Kinos; a failing block is dropped and logged, never refusing the plugin; consents on update come first
- [Structure a bigger plugin](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/structure/): src/ by responsibility, src/plugin.js only re-exports, a deterministic esbuild bundle committed as plugin.js with a generated-file banner, check:built, the build script and npm scripts, the workflow (build, test, sign, validate); kinotvapp/kino-plugin-news and kinotvapp/kino-plugin-watch-party as examples
- [Exporting and importing a plugin file](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/plugin-files/): Kino 0.9.74: the .kinoplugin file (a ZIP with the manifest, entry, icons and kino-export.json with sha256s), the signature kept and the author key pinned, sealed secrets that do not travel, modifying and re-sharing as an unsigned local plugin, caps
- [Live channels](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/live-channels/): live items (in Home rows from apiVersion 6), the channels capability, M3U/XMLTV playlists, guide, liveSearch (searching a big catalog; 18+ marks on hits) and load-more paging, adult categories/channels, liveStreamHosts, three recipes
- [Music and podcasts](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/music/): apiVersion 8 (Kino 0.9.54) audio items: kind "music" (album, playlist, track) and "podcast" (show, audiobook, radio), optional artist, episodes() must answer every audio ref (even a single track) when declared, else the item's ref goes to resolve, dropped below apiVersion 8, details reserved; the reference audio plugin kinotvapp/kino-plugin-archive-audio
- [Customize your plugin](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/customize/): one table of everything a plugin can change in how Kino shows it (name, icon, color, marketplace chips, settings tab, status lines and buttons, theme colors, own section with tabs and hero, Categorías tiles, Home rows with genre and channels, 18+ marks, Servidor menu labels and lazy copies, skip buttons, audio/subtitle labels, userMessage, subtitles, meta, channels), with short examples and what cannot be changed
- [The settings form](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/settings-form/): every field type (text, password, url, toggle, select, list, apiVersion 6 section/status/action, and the apiVersion 12 configuration aids link and help) with what kino.config returns, every attribute (key, label, hint, required, default, options, fields, max, confirm, url, title, body, devices, linkOnly) and its limits, defaults when omitted, no conditional fields, password vs sealed secrets; settingsStatus, action with clearSettings, setSettings (Kino 0.9.74: fill your own text/select settings; a password from apiVersion 13) and link ("Is this you?", Kino 0.9.74), validateSettings, a complete example, each plugin's own Ajustes tab, what syncs to the person's other devices From apiVersion 13 (in development) the qr type (one with no text draws nothing), settingsStatus answering hide: [keys], and "sync": false on a password or a text (the value stays on the device where it was typed; a password may go once in sync.provision, never as keySecret; a text never).
- [Signing every request](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/signed-streams/): apiVersion 6 request-signed HLS streams: signing "request", signContext, the sign export and its restricted signing lane (1.5 s, no network/storage), resolve(ref, { retry }) on 409/401/403, alternateHosts failover, casting through the phone
- [Hidden browser](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/browser/): apiVersion 6 "browser": true or "pages" (red consent line, resolve 75 s): kino.browser.capture (only in a resolve the person started; returns the page's held video requests with headers and cookies to pass on) and kino.browser.page ("pages" only; a page's HTML once the site's automatic check passes by itself; not from categories; every top-level redirect/navigation must stay on the plugin's hosts or the read ends blocked; 20 reads/min; timeoutMs cut to the call's remaining time minus 1.5 s); prefer kino.fetch; safety model (loopback proxy, per-capture credential, pinned vetted IPs, never the home network, one page at a time, wiped cookies); Kino never solves a captcha (blocked); timeouts, errors (blocked, timeout, busy, browser_unavailable, not_allowed, rate_limited), a complete example with labelled lazy copies
- [Moving saved titles](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/migrate/): apiVersion 6 migrate capability: claim saved library titles, chapters and live favorites Kino can no longer open
- [Home categories](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/categories/): the optional Home by categories (one flat list of category rows with no tabs: genre rows merged across types, full rows for thematic types, leftover rows for genre-less titles of generic types, audio rows last, fixed order; one card per title, built from what Home rows cached): declare genre on each home() row and genres on each item, preferably with the ids in the vocabulary tables (video/audio types and genres, aliases in Spanish and English), invent a new category only when nothing fits (appended at the end); send ids.tmdb and year so titles merge; live categories and playlists keep the closed ten ids
- [Section, categories and colors](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/section-theme/): apiVersion 6 section (own TV sidebar entry / phone chip with tabs, hero, rows), categories (tiles in Categorías), theme (five colors with readability guardrails)
- [The player panel](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/player-panel/): apiVersion 9 (Kino 0.9.55) manifest panel (label, icon or 96x96 iconFile), panel(context) and panelAction(event, context) (elements, rows/cols/cards, tabs, values saved per video or per plugin, synced), player actions (seekToMs, seekStepMs, speed, resize, skip, markers, autoNext), playerEvent, settingsLayout, kit commands (panel, panelAction, playerEvent), the loading element (Kino 0.9.64, additive, context.features)
- [Playlists](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/contract/#playlists): apiVersion 10 (Kino 0.9.65) playlists capability -- a plugin's own account playlists (not the pre-existing KinoPlaylist M3U/IPTV list, not sign's kind: "playlist"), six independently-optional exports (playlists, playlistItems, playlistCreate, playlistAddItem, playlistRemoveItem, playlistReorder), playlistItems answers the same Page shape as browse; a contract only, no installed or announced plugin uses it and Kino doesn't wire it into any screen yet
- [Logs and telemetry](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/diagnostics/): the "Modo debug" switch every plugin has from Kino 0.9.50 ("debug": true only makes it on by default; on-screen errors, Registro page), telemetry true/"verbose" (opt-in error reports with consent; only declared plugins send log lines; a per-device switch comes later), kino.log.report, logcat tags KinoPlugin/<id> and KinoPlay, playback metrics
- [Limits and engine quirks](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/engine-limits/): every limit, sandbox lifecycle, missing globals in QuickJS, splitting code across files with esbuild, the unhandled-rejection trap
- [Test it locally](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/test-locally/): sdk/run.mjs, sdk/validate.mjs, record/replay fixtures, live-channel commands, apiVersion 6 commands (section, categories, theme, settingsStatus, action, validateSettings, migrate, sign, --retry, --within), kino.meta/kino.tmdb in the kit (KINO_META_FIXTURE, KINO_TMDB_KEY, KINO_TMDB_FIXTURE), what Node does not reproduce apiVersion 13 (in development) in the kit: kino.ws over Node WebSocket, byte streams checked by run.mjs resolve, run.mjs read (--size) and image (--out) commands, askRead and askImage, kino.catalog in memory, storageLarge, a qrScan fake, init.mjs --with byteSource,images,catalog,socket.
- [Publishing](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/publish/): versions and approvals (startup update check, pending-update badge and error hint), sharing by manifest URL, and every requirement to appear in the community list (topic kino-plugin)
- [What people see](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/what-people-see/): consent sheet, host dialogs, player messages, statuses, uninstalling, sending to the TV (Chromecast/DLNA), plugins synced across devices, what Kino 0.9.50 does for every plugin (play on the paired TV, new chapters, Para ti)
- [Cookbook](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/cookbook/): HTML site with login, JSON API with token, the person's own server, three sync providers (Sync Servidor on the person's own server, Sync-Gram on a Telegram bot, Sync-Gram Cuenta on the person's own Telegram account), a TMDB catalog with kino.tmdb (no key in the plugin, fallback setting on older Kino, no_tmdb_key handled), Widevine, plain http
- [Stremio addons](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/stremio/): how people install a Stremio addon by its manifest URL (Kino generates a plugin; the address stays in two settings, the configuration part sealed), how catalog/meta/stream/subtitles/addon_catalog and the search/skip extras map to Home rows, En vivo, search and paging (a required genre extra is left out), stream ranking, alternatives ("Opción N" in the Servidor menu), proxyHeaders.request, notWebReady ranked last, what is refused (torrents/P2P/infoHash always, even with debrid; no local streaming server), configurable and configurationRequired addons, 18+ addons behind the 18+ code, collections, catalog redirect discovery, phone-TV sync, limits, the messages people see, and when to write a Kino plugin instead
- [Nuvio scrapers](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/nuvio/): how Kino installs Nuvio scrapers by converting them (version 1.<converter revision>.0, typed search through TMDB, sealed TMDB key), and the limits and globals only converted scrapers get (not for hand-written plugins)
- [Plugins that use Nuvio scrapers](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/nuvio-plugins/): Kino 0.9.71, apiVersion 11: the nuvio capability and nuvioRepos (1 to 4 repositories); kino.nuvio.available/use/scrapers/streams give a plugin the links found by a Nuvio repository's scrapers, which the plugin sorts and merges; limits, ownership of the scrapers, a complete example and the types
- [CloudStream plugins](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/cloudstream/): Kino 0.9.54: how people add a CloudStream repository (repo.json/plugins.json, cloudstreamrepo:// and https://cs.repo/? links, CloudStream short codes -- cutt.ly, or py.md with a leading ! -- asked once without following the redirect and confirmed by the person, public https .json targets only) and pick plugins (Spanish first, torrent-declaring plugins refused, NSFW behind the 18+ code), the complement app with no internet (Kino makes every request, any public https host), what the generated plugin is (version 1.<converter revision>.<entry version>, apiVersion 8, kino.cloudstream), how search/main page/load/loadLinks and each tvType map (Live to En vivo, Music/Audio to music, Podcast/AudioBook to podcast), the plugin's own settings screen (phones and tablets only), the 45 s list limit, updates, sync, and tips for repository maintainers (not for hand-written plugins)

- [Claims and plugin takedowns](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/claims/): Kino is a player; community plugins are an automatic index (listed, not recommended or promoted; each author is responsible for their plugin); how to file a claim or report a rule-breaking plugin ("Reclamo / retiro de plugin" issue template), community-blocklist.json and its reasons (claim, malware, broken, rules, author_request), what happens to installed copies, how authors appeal

## Reference

- [contract.json](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/reference/contract.json): every number and rule the app enforces (machine-readable)
- [kino.d.ts](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/reference/kino.d.ts): TypeScript declarations of the kino API and every shape
- [Example plugins](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/examples/): the three published examples, Internet Archive Audio among them, and the three example sync providers in public repositories ([Sync-Gram](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-sync-gram), [Sync Servidor](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-sync-server), [Sync-Gram Cuenta](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-sync-gram-account)) (and [Maratón](https://github.com/xuper-plugin/maraton), a community plugin that uses the hidden browser and labelled lazy copies; Kino only lists community plugins)
- [kinotvapp/kino-plugin-own-server](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-own-server): the complete API reference and template ("Tu servidor" 1.5.0, apiVersion 7) -- every setting type and the settings form, auth, kino.storage, downloads, copies, request signing, live items and channels in every shape, a section, migrate, meta, subtitles, tracking and segments. Raw files: [plugin.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-own-server/main/plugin.js), [kino-plugin.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-own-server/main/kino-plugin.json)
- [kinotvapp/kino-plugin-archive](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-archive): the simplest template to start from, with the sdk/ kit -- start here for a plain plugin with no settings or login
- [kinotvapp/kino-plugin-ui-gallery](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-ui-gallery): apiVersion 14 (Kino 0.9.74+): every screen component drawn on the device, by tabs
- [kinotvapp/kino-plugin-news](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-news): apiVersion 14: "Solo noticias", a screen, a background job, kino.shared and optional kino.ai; src/ bundled with esbuild
- [kinotvapp/kino-plugin-watch-party](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-watch-party): apiVersion 14: "Party Chat", a player-panel tab with rooms, a chat and playerControl; src/ bundled with esbuild
- [kinotvapp/kino-plugin-archive-audio](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugin-archive-audio): the reference audio plugin ("Internet Archive Audio", apiVersion 8, Kino 0.9.54) -- music and podcast items, episodes() for every album, audiobook and show, labelled lazy copies per audio format, a section and Categorías tiles

## Optional

- [Build a plugin with AI](https://kinotvapp.github.io/kino-plugins/en/ai/): what a non-programmer needs first, a ready-to-paste prompt, a filled-in example, and what to do when something fails
- [Markdown sources](https://github.com/kinotvapp/kino-plugins/tree/main/docs): the pages as Markdown (English: *.en.md, Spanish: *.md)
